facts: About 527,000 people (2021 census), a quarter of the country
On the Vardar River in the Skopje Valley
worth_knowing: Founded as Scupi in the late 1st century under Domitian, it was abandoned in 518 after an earthquake destroyed it. It was rebuilt under Justinian I and ruled by the Ottomans for over five centuries.
